name: axis-migrate
description: Migrate a messy legacy GIS project (PyQGIS, ArcPy, notebooks, Excel) to a geopandas/rasterio pipeline and prove per-step parity against the legacy run's own intermediates and finals, with computed, honest status. Codex build: skills and scripts only, no hooks (see CODEX.md).

interface.shortDescription: Legacy GIS to geopandas/rasterio with per-step parity proof
interface.longDescription: Discover a read-only legacy GIS folder, investigate and interview, plan, migrate step by step, run under a read ledger, compare every step against the legacy intermediates and finals, seal the evidence and compute the status with ladder.py. Under Codex there are no hooks: the script halves are the guards (CODEX.md), and the start skill is the entry point.
defaultPrompt: Use $axis-migrate:start to migrate the legacy GIS folder ./legacy
Run ladder.py from the axis-migrate report skill on ./migration and quote its status line
